## Summary

Maintainer-use template. External pull requests are not currently accepted;
please follow the discussion policy in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

<!-- Brief description of changes -->

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Adapter addition
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] Strict-warning unit tests and statement/branch coverage pass; existing skips and unrun integration tests are disclosed
- [ ] Repository hooks run with the explicit Python >=3.11 tool environment; applicable dependency audits pass
- [ ] Reviewed untracked files receive explicit hook coverage as well as tracked files
- [ ] Both README languages and contribution guides updated where applicable
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Current version metadata and bilingual documentation agree; historical entries preserved
- [ ] No credentials, session content, private paths, or raw diagnostics included in changes or attachments
- [ ] Distribution identity and clean-install checks recorded if packaging changed; tests not run are stated explicitly
- [ ] Guarded build uses a new output directory; old records/artifacts preserved and no publication implied
- [ ] Local CI, GitHub-hosted CI, installed-package checks and authenticated provider results are distinguished
- [ ] Documentation-component inheritance names unchanged inputs; changed assertions have fresh evidence
